title: Record the prefix-budget counterexample
body:
## Summary
- The length-8 word `01021323` has prefix set `{0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12}` and covers all 16 masks in dimension 4.
- Its bit-0 collision excess is 8, which is above the balanced budget 5 and at most the actual class budget 9.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged, and this check does not decide `f(7)`.
